name: 457. A client config read from /api/config saves back unchanged, and log_retention_days reads as the retention applied (config round trip)
description: TXE-7070. A gateway whose config never set client.log_retention_days read 0 from GET /api/config, and PUT /api/config refused that same object with 400 "log_retention_days must be at least 1", so a settings page that changes one field could not save. Such a gateway prunes logs at the documented default, 365 days, and now reads as 365, from memory and from the store; the object saves back unchanged. Runs on the provider error fixture gateway (tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, whose client section does not set the field) with providerErrorFixture=1; skipped otherwise. No upstream call. Run with FEATURE="config round trip".

item.name: 457.1 fixture gateway reads its client config from memory: log_retention_days is the default it applies (config round trip)

exec: if (pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixture') !== '1') {
pm.execution.skipRequest();
var t = pm.response.text();
pm.test('the client config is readable', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, t.slice(0, 400)).to.equal(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().client_config, t.slice(0, 400)).to.be.an('object'); });
var cc = pm.response.json().client_config || {};
// The fixture config's client section does not set log_retention_days. The gateway prunes at the
// documented default, 365, and must report that, not 0: a save refuses a value below 1 (TXE-7070).
pm.test('log_retention_days reads as the default 365', function () { pm.expect(cc.log_retention_days, t.slice(0, 400)).to.equal(365); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('h457ClientConfig', JSON.stringify(cc));

item.name: 457.2 fixture gateway saves the client config read from memory back unchanged (config round trip)

exec: if (pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixture') !== '1') {
pm.execution.skipRequest();
} else {
var saved = pm.collectionVariables.get('h457ClientConfig');
if (!saved) { throw new Error('457.1 must run first: it stores the client config this save sends back'); }
pm.request.body.raw = JSON.stringify({ client_config: JSON.parse(saved) });
// Every field as GET returned it, none changed: a read must always save back (TXE-7070). Before the fix
// this answered 400 "log_retention_days must be at least 1".
pm.test('the unchanged client config is accepted', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text().slice(0, 400)).to.equal(200); });
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}') + '/api/config', method: 'GET', header: { 'X-Bifrost-Setup-Token': 'bifrost-e2e-setup-token' } }, function (err, res) {

pm.test('log_retention_days still reads 365 after the save', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.json().client_config.log_retention_days, res.text().slice(0, 400)).to.equal(365); });
